name: woocommerce/orders-query
label: Query orders
description: Find orders by ID or common order filters.

name: woocommerce/order-add-note
label: Add order note
description: Add a note to an order.

name: woocommerce/order-create
label: Create order
description: Create an order, as the order screen does, for example for a phone order. Without customer_id, the order is a guest order. Without status, the order gets the default status of the store, which is pending payment unless an extension changes it. A processing, on-hold or completed status reduces the stock of the products and sends the order emails to the store and the customer, so confirm the status before you send it.

name: woocommerce/order-notes-query
label: Query order notes
description: List every note of an order, newest first.

name: woocommerce/order-send-email
label: Send order email
description: Send an order email to the customer again.

name: woocommerce/order-delete
label: Delete order
description: Move an order to the trash, or delete it permanently.

name: woocommerce/order-update
label: Update order
description: Update the addresses, customer note, product lines and shipping lines of an order. Fields that are not sent keep their value. Changing lines recalculates the totals and needs an order status that allows editing. Use the woocommerce/order-update-status ability to change the status.

name: woocommerce/order-update-status
label: Update order status
description: Update an order status.

name: woocommerce/payment-gateways-query
label: Query payment gateways
description: List the payment gateways in checkout order, enabled or not, or get one by ID.

name: woocommerce/payment-gateway-update
label: Update payment gateway
description: Turn a payment gateway on or off, change its checkout title, or move it in the checkout order. Cannot change other gateway settings or credentials.

name: woocommerce/products-query
label: Query products
description: Find products by ID or common catalog filters.

name: woocommerce/product-terms-query
label: Query product terms
description: Find product categories, tags, brands or the terms of a global attribute, such as pa_color. Use include to retrieve specific term IDs.

name: woocommerce/product-term-create
label: Create product term
description: Create a product category, tag, brand or a term of a global attribute, such as pa_color. Product writes then assign it by ID.

name: woocommerce/product-term-update
label: Update product term
description: Change the name, slug, parent or description of a product category, tag, brand or global attribute term. Fields left out keep their value.

name: woocommerce/product-reviews-query
label: Query product reviews
description: Read product reviews, ratings and moderation status. Search matches review text only, never reviewer identity. Summary and per-product ranking cover all reviews in the requested product/status scope, ignoring search, rating range and include. Unrated reviews have rating zero and do not affect averages. Ranking is worst first; above 200 products it keeps the 100 worst and 100 best rated. Text searches omit the ranking. Requested products without reviews and unknown product IDs are reported separately. store_reply_count counts replies from store staff only, so a review with only customer replies has 0. Reviewer identity is withheld.

name: woocommerce/product-review-update
label: Update product review
description: Moderate a product review, or a reply to one: approve it, hold it for moderation (shown as Pending in wp-admin), mark it as spam or move it to the trash. Moderate for spam, abuse or off-topic content, never to hide negative reviews. Requesting the status a review already has changes nothing and returns changed false. Reviewer identity is withheld.

name: woocommerce/product-review-reply
label: Reply to product review
description: Publish a reply to an approved product review, as the current user and under their display name. Approve a held review with woocommerce/product-review-update first. Check the review's store_reply_count first, so the store does not answer it twice. A reply can be held or trashed with woocommerce/product-review-update. Replies to replies are not supported.

name: woocommerce/product-attributes-query
label: Query product attributes
description: Find the global product attributes, such as Color or Size, with their terms. Use include to retrieve specific attribute IDs.

name: woocommerce/product-attribute-create
label: Create product attribute
description: Create a global product attribute, such as Color or Size. Product writes then use it by ID or name, with global set to true, and create its terms from the options they send.

name: woocommerce/product-create
label: Create product
description: Create a product using supported catalog fields.

name: woocommerce/product-delete
label: Delete product
description: Move a product to the trash, or delete it permanently.

name: woocommerce/product-update
label: Update product
description: Update an existing product using supported catalog fields.

name: woocommerce/shipping-zones-query
label: Query shipping zones
description: List shipping zones in matching order, with the regions each covers and its shipping methods. Zone 0 covers every location no other zone matches.

name: woocommerce/system-status-tools-query
label: Query status tools
description: List the maintenance tools under WooCommerce > Status > Tools, in screen order, and what each does. Run a runnable one with woocommerce/system-status-tool-run.

name: woocommerce/system-status-tool-run
label: Run status tool
description: Run a maintenance tool from WooCommerce > Status > Tools that clears caches or rebuilds derived data. Only tools that woocommerce/system-status-tools-query marks as runnable can be run.

name: woocommerce/shipping-zone-create
label: Create shipping zone
description: Create a shipping zone for a set of regions. It has no methods yet; add them with shipping-zone-method-create. A customer gets the first zone in order that matches their address.

name: woocommerce/shipping-zone-method-create
label: Add shipping method to zone
description: Add a flat rate, free shipping or local pickup method to a shipping zone, with its settings. Zone 0 covers every location no other zone matches.

name: woocommerce/shipping-zone-method-update
label: Update shipping method
description: Turn a flat rate, free shipping or local pickup method of a zone on or off, move it, or change its settings, such as the cost or the free shipping minimum. Get the instance_id from shipping-zones-query.

name: woocommerce/tax-rates-query
label: Query tax rates
description: List the tax rates of every tax class, in the order of the tax settings.

name: woocommerce/customers-query
label: Query customers
description: Find registered customers by ID or role, with their order count and total spent. Names, usernames, emails, phone numbers and addresses are withheld. Guest customers are not included.
